name: GigaChad

skins.name: Pepsi
skins.lore: Pepsiman, the mascot created for Pepsi commercials and video games, known for delivering Pepsi while sprinting through increasingly chaotic obstacles.

skins.name: Saitama
skins.lore: Saitama from One-Punch Man, a hero capable of defeating nearly any opponent with a single punch after years of intense training.

skins.name: All Might
skins.lore: All Might from My Hero Academia, the Symbol of Peace who dedicates his strength to protecting others and inspiring future heroes.

skins.name: Terrence
skins.lore: Terrence from The Angry Birds Movie, the silent but incredibly powerful bird whose strength often speaks louder than words.

skins.name: Squid
skins.lore: Handsome Squidward, the legendary version of Squidward Tentacles whose unexpectedly perfect appearance became one of Bikini Bottom's most famous moments.

skins.name: Red Hulk
skins.lore: Red Hulk from Captain America: Brave New World, where President Thaddeus Ross transforms into a powerful red-skinned monster driven by rage.

skins.name: MX
skins.lore: Mario MX from Mario '85, a sinister reinterpretation of the Mushroom Kingdom hero associated with the dark events surrounding the abandoned game.

skins.name: The Thing
skins.lore: Ben Grimm, also known as The Thing, from The Fantastic Four: First Steps, a founding member of the team whose rocky form grants him immense strength and durability.

lore: Gigachad is an internet icon known for his legendary confidence, discipline, and unmatched presence. Originally inspired by a real-life model, he became a symbol of self-improvement, determination, and peak masculinity across countless online communities.
